capabilities: Create monster and item set templates in vault folders
Insert and roll encounter tables with die ranges and monster lists
Generate random shops with an NPC and inventory from defined item sets
Generate and edit PC and NPC character sheets
extras: The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README includes a third-party license disclaimer stating it is not affiliated with The Arcane Library, LLC.
motivation: The author built it to make things easier for Shadowdark GMs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for Shadowdark game masters to generate and manage encounters, monsters, characters, and shop inventories.

relations.evidence: an independent product published under the Shadowdark RPG Third-Party License and is not affiliated with The Arcane Library

summary: A Shadowdark RPG toolkit for game masters that generates encounter tables, NPC/PC character sheets, and random shops in the vault.
